newsitem.title: UK: Horse racing-Pitman drops hint for Nahthen Lad.
newsitem.headline: Horse racing-Pitman drops hint for Nahthen Lad.

text.p: Trainer Jenny Pitman, twice a winner of the Grand National, gave a strong hint on Friday for Nahthen Lad, one of her two runners in Saturday's big race.
Nahthen Lad, a 16-1 chance, was thought good enough to run in last month's Cheltenham Gold Cup but failed to handle the fast ground and had to be pulled up.
Pitman said: "He came back from there with sore shins. We've got those settled and we're happy with him."
As a top novice last year Nahthen Lad beat Mr Mulligan who took the Cheltenham Gold Cup three weeks ago.

Pitman, who won the National in 1983 with Corbiere and two years ago with Royal Athlete, said: "If Nahthen Lad can recapture anything like last year's form he's going to have a hell of a chance in tomorrow's race."
The ground for Saturday is described officially as good after more watering overnight.
Jason Titley, who won on Royal Athlete, will partner Nahthen Lad while ex-champion Richard Dunwoody rides Pitman's other runner, Smith's Band, who is also quoted at 16-1.
